name: L11 · 看来我没办法解决这个问题
titleCn: 看来我没办法解决这个问题
titleEn: It seems I can't solve this problem

title.cn: 在办公室讨论会议安排
title.en: Discussing the meeting arrangements in the office

intro.cn: 在办公室里，王一雪跟杨同乐在讨论工作。
intro.en: In the office, Wang Yixue and Yang Tongle were discussing work.

questions.q: 王一雪和杨同乐在说什么？
杨同乐为什么要给大家发邮件？
options: 告诉大家带笔记本电脑
告诉大家会议时间和地点

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 会议下午几点开始？
lines.en: What time does the meeting start this afternoon？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 今天下午经理不在，不开会了。
lines.en: The manager isn't available this afternoon, so the meeting has been canceled.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那什么时候开会？
lines.en: Then when will it be held？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 后天上午十点，会议地点换到第一会议室。我正要给大家发邮件。
lines.en: At 10 a.m. the day after tomorrow. The location has been changed to Meeting Room 1. I'm about to send everyone an email.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 开会的时候，我们用会议室的电脑还是自己的笔记本电脑？
lines.en: For the meeting, should we use the room's computer or bring our own？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 会议室的电脑或者自己的电脑都可以。
lines.en: Either works.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那到时候咱们早点儿过去，你帮我把电脑接好吧。
lines.en: Let's go a bit earlier then—can you help me set up the computer？

postQuestions.q: 会议换到了什么时间和地点？
王一雪需要杨同乐帮忙做什么？

title.en: Preparing for the meeting in the meeting room

intro.cn: 在会议室，王一雪跟杨同乐在做会前准备。
intro.en: In the meeting room, Wang Yixue and Yang Tongle were preparing for the meeting.

questions.q: 杨同乐在帮助王一雪做什么？
杨同乐解决这个问题了吗？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 电脑接好了吗？
lines.en: Is the computer set up？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 已经接好了，您开机看看有没有问题。
lines.en: It's already set up. Go ahead and turn it on to see if there's any issue.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 现在什么都看不见。
lines.en: I can't see anything at the moment.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 我检查一下哪里出问题了……您再试一下。
lines.en: Let me check what's wrong… Try again.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 看见了，但是听不见声音。
lines.en: Now I can see, but there's no sound.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 现在呢？
lines.en: How about now？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 听得见声音，但是声音有点儿小，听不清楚。
lines.en: I can hear it now, but it's still too quiet to hear clearly.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 看来我没办法解决这个问题，只能找别人来帮帮忙了。
lines.en: Looks like I can't fix this problem. We'll have to ask someone else for help.

postQuestions.q: 开机以后，电脑有什么问题？
杨同乐检查以后，电脑怎么样了？
听见声音以后，又出现了什么问题？

title.en: Chatting about work progress in the office

intro.cn: 在办公室里，王一雪跟杨同乐在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the office, Wang Yixue and Yang Tongle were chatting.

questions.q: 王一雪这几天为什么特别忙？
杨同乐吃完饭要做什么？

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 同乐，你看见老张了吗？
lines.en: Tongle, have you seen Lao Zhang？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 老张没来。他说家里有点儿事，所以请假了。
lines.en: He didn't come in today. He said he had some family matters to take care of, so he took the day off.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 好几个同事都休假了，开会前这么多工作我怕干不完。
lines.en: Quite a few colleagues are on leave. I'm worried I won't be able to finish all this work before the meeting.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 十二点多了，咱们先去吃饭吧。吃完饭，我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
lines.en: It's already past twelve. Let's grab some lunch first. After we eat, I'll help you finish these tasks.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 你先去吃，我想再干一会儿。明天开会前要发到公司的邮箱里。
lines.en: You go ahead—I'll keep working for a bit longer. I need to send this to the company's email address before tomorrow's meeting.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 您没看到邮件吗？经理还没回来呢，下周才能开会。
lines.en: Didn't you see the email? The manager isn't back yet, so the meeting's been postponed to next week.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.cn: 那不着急了。走，吃饭去。
lines.en: That's a relief! Let's go eat.

postQuestions.q: 老张今天为什么没来上班？
王一雪为什么没时间吃饭？

intro.cn: 在家里，王一雪在写日记。
intro.en: At home, Wang Yixue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 王一雪最近在想什么问题？
options: 喜欢不喜欢现在的工作
愿意不愿意去别的城市工作

questions.q: 王一雪为什么不想去上海工作？

lines.cn: 前几天，上海的同事来北京了。
lines.en: A few days ago, some colleagues from Shanghai visited Beijing.

lines.cn: 一起吃饭时，他们跟我说最近有不少同事去上海工作了，问我愿意不愿意也去上海。
lines.en: During dinner, they told me that many coworkers had recently moved to Shanghai for work and asked if I'd be willing to go there too.

lines.cn: 我是这样想的：现在丈夫和孩子都在北京，刘明的工作很忙，小雪和小明也还小，我去别的城市工作就要离开他们。
lines.en: Here's how I feel about it: Right now, my husband and children are in Beijing. Liu Ming's job is very demanding, and Xiaoxue and Xiaoming are still young. If I were to work in another city, I'd have to leave them behind.

lines.cn: 虽然去上海可能会有更好的机会，但是对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为工作或学习离开家人。
lines.en: While Shanghai might offer better career opportunities, life itself is just as important to me. I'm not willing to leave my family behind for work or study.

postQuestions.q: 上海的同事告诉王一雪什么了？
王一雪觉得去上海工作有什么好处？
对王一雪来说，工作和生活哪个更重要？

grammar.note: “还是”一般用在疑问句中，提出两个或多个选项，希望对方从中做出选择。“或者”主要用在陈述句中，不能用在疑问句中。
grammar.noteEn: “还是” is typically used in interrogative sentences to present two or more options, asking the listener to choose one. “或者” is usually used in declarative sentences, not in interrogative ones.

items.c: 我们用会议室的电脑还是自己的笔记本电脑？
items.en: Should we use the room's computer or bring our own laptop？

items.c: 我们今天去、明天去还是后天去？
items.en: Are we going today, tomorrow, or the day after tomorrow？

items.c: 会议室的电脑或者自己的电脑都可以。
items.en: Either the room's computer or your own computer is fine.

items.c: 你可以坐地铁或者打车去学校。
items.en: You can go to school by subway or by taxi.

grammar.note: 固定短语“看来”后面加上一个结论，表示说话人通过观察、思考后，对当前情况的分析或推测。
grammar.noteEn: The set phrase “看来” is used to introduce a conclusion expressing the speaker's analysis or inference of the current situation, based on observation or reflection.

items.c: 看来我没办法解决这个问题。
items.en: It seems I can't solve this problem.

items.c: 这么晚了，看来他今天不会来了。
items.en: It's so late—it looks like he isn't coming today.

items.c: 电梯坏了，看来咱们只能走下去了。
items.en: The elevator is broken, so it looks like we'll have to walk down.

grammar.note: “把”字句表示动作对确定的人或事物产生某种结果。基本结构：主语＋把＋宾语＋动词＋结果补语。
grammar.noteEn: The “把” sentence is used to indicate that an action performed on a definite person or thing produces a certain result. Basic structure: Subject+把+Object+Verb+Complement of Result.

items.c: 我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
items.en: I'll finish this work together with you.

items.c: 他还没把笔记本电脑接好呢。
items.en: He hasn't finished setting up the laptop yet.

grammar.note: 固定格式“对……来说”指明观点、感受或情况所属的对象。
grammar.noteEn: The fixed pattern “对…来说” indicates the person or group to whom a viewpoint, feeling, or situation applies.

items.c: 对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为工作或学习离开家人。
items.en: To me, life is also important. I'm not willing to leave my family behind for work or study.

items.c: 对她来说，学习汉语很有意思。
items.en: For her, learning Chinese is very interesting.

items.c: 对孩子来说，玩也是一种学习。
items.en: For children, playing is also a kind of learning.

items.c: 那到时候咱们早点儿过去，你帮我把电脑接好吧。
items.en: Let's go a bit earlier then—can you help me set up the computer？

classroomActivity.description: 四人一组，轮流描述一个职业，其他人猜。描述时不能直接说出职业的名称，而要用几句话来介绍这个工作的内容、场所、穿着等。回答时，使用本课所学的词语和语言点。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in groups of four. Take turns describing a profession for the others to guess. When describing, do not directly mention the name of the profession. Instead, use a few sentences to talk about the job's responsibilities, workplace, attire, and other details. When responding, use the words and language points covered in this lesson.

topics.cn: 例如：对很多人来说，如果身体不舒服就会去找他。
